# Prayag Hospital & Research Centre

> Prayag Hospital & Research Centre is a 120-bed, NABH- and NABL-accredited multispeciality hospital in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India, with a second facility in Greater Noida. Founded in 1995 by Dr. B. P. Singh as Prayag Orthopedic Centre, it offers 24x7 emergency care, critical care, and seven Centres of Excellence, with 100+ doctors and 500+ paramedical staff.

Key facts:

- Main hospital: J-206/A-1, Sector 41, Near Noida City Centre Metro Station, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301, India
- Greater Noida facility: NH-021, Block M, Delta III, Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201310, India
- Phone: 0120-4021900, 0120-4021914 (24x7 emergency services available)
- Patient enquiries: crm@prayaghospital.in
- Billing, TPA and insurance: tpa@prayaghospital.in
- Media and marketing: marketing@prayaghospital.in
- Accreditations: NABH (hospital), NABL (laboratory)
- Leadership: Dr. B. P. Singh (Founder & Chairman, Prayag Group), Mrs. Sunita Singh (Managing Director), Pritika Singh (Chief Executive Officer)

For medical emergencies, patients should call the hospital directly or go to the nearest emergency department. Information on this site is general and is not a substitute for a consultation with a doctor.

## Patient Services

- [Book an Appointment](https://www.prayaghospital.in/book-appointment): Request an OPD appointment with a Prayag Hospital doctor
- [Find a Doctor](https://www.prayaghospital.in/find-doctor): Directory of doctors with speciality and experience
- [Admission Guide](https://www.prayaghospital.in/admission-guide): What to expect and bring for inpatient admission
- [TPA & Insurance](https://www.prayaghospital.in/tpa-insurance): Health insurance and third-party administrator (TPA) information
- [Government Panels](https://www.prayaghospital.in/govt-panel): Government health schemes and panels the hospital is empanelled with
- [Visiting Hours](https://www.prayaghospital.in/visiting-hours): Visiting times and rules for inpatient visitors
- [Health Check-Ups](https://www.prayaghospital.in/health-checkup): Preventive health checkup packages
- [Contact Us](https://www.prayaghospital.in/contact-us): Addresses, phone numbers, emails and directions

## Centres of Excellence

- [Cardiac Sciences](https://www.prayaghospital.in/cardiac-care): Heart care, cardiology and cardiac procedures
- [Neurosciences](https://www.prayaghospital.in/neuroscience): Neurology and neurosurgery for brain, spine and nerve conditions
- [Orthopedics & Joint Replacement](https://www.prayaghospital.in/orthopedics): Bone, joint, trauma and joint replacement surgery
- [Mother & Child Care](https://www.prayaghospital.in/obstetrics-gynecology): Obstetrics, gynaecology, pregnancy and delivery care
- [Gastroenterology & Hepatology](https://www.prayaghospital.in/gastroenterology): Digestive system and liver care
- [Renal Sciences (Kidney Care)](https://www.prayaghospital.in/nephrology-dialysis): Nephrology and dialysis
- [Oncology (Cancer Care)](https://www.prayaghospital.in/oncology): Cancer diagnosis and treatment, including medical oncology

## Clinical Departments

- [Internal & Family Medicine](https://www.prayaghospital.in/internal-medicine): General medicine, diabetes and chronic disease care
- [Critical Care & ICU](https://www.prayaghospital.in/critical-care): Intensive care with 24/7 monitoring and life support
- [Emergency Medicine](https://www.prayaghospital.in/emergency-medicine): 24x7 emergency and trauma care
- [Minimally Invasive Surgery](https://www.prayaghospital.in/general-surgery): Laparoscopic and general surgery
- [Pediatric Surgery](https://www.prayaghospital.in/pediatric-surgery): Surgical care for infants and children
- [Neonatology](https://www.prayaghospital.in/neonatology): Newborn and paediatric care, including neonatal intensive care
- [Vascular Surgery](https://www.prayaghospital.in/vascular-surgery): Treatment of arterial and venous conditions
- [Respiratory Medicine](https://www.prayaghospital.in/respiratory-medicine): Lung and breathing disorders
- [ENT & Cochlear Implant](https://www.prayaghospital.in/ent): Ear, nose and throat care, including cochlear implants
- [Urology](https://www.prayaghospital.in/urology): Urinary tract, kidney stone, prostate care and urodynamics
- [Dermatology](https://www.prayaghospital.in/dermatology): Skin, hair and nail care
- [Plastic Surgery](https://www.prayaghospital.in/plastic-surgery): Reconstructive and cosmetic surgery
- [Psychiatry](https://www.prayaghospital.in/psychiatry): Mental health care
- [Dental Science](https://www.prayaghospital.in/dental-science): Dental care
- [Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery](https://www.prayaghospital.in/oral-maxillofacial-surgery): Surgery of the jaw, face and mouth
- [Ophthalmology](https://www.prayaghospital.in/ophthalmology): Eye care

## Diagnostics & Support Services

- [Radiology & Imaging](https://www.prayaghospital.in/radiology): CT, MRI, X-ray and ultrasound imaging
- [Laboratory Services](https://www.prayaghospital.in/pathology): NABL-accredited pathology and laboratory testing
- [EMG/EP (Nerve & Muscle)](https://www.prayaghospital.in/emg-ep): Nerve conduction and electromyography studies
- [Anesthesiology](https://www.prayaghospital.in/anesthesiology): Anaesthesia and perioperative care
- [Physiotherapy & Rehab](https://www.prayaghospital.in/physiotherapy): Physical therapy and rehabilitation
- [Dietetics & Nutrition](https://www.prayaghospital.in/dietetics): Clinical nutrition and diet counselling
- [Blood Bank](https://www.prayaghospital.in/blood-bank): In-house blood bank
- [Pharmacy](https://www.prayaghospital.in/pharmacy): In-house pharmacy
- [Support Services](https://www.prayaghospital.in/support-services): Other patient support services
